description: Godot node: move a node under a different parent (and/or to a child index), keeping its global transform by default.

new_parent.description: New parent path; "." for the root.

path.description: Node path relative to the scene root ("." is the root), e.g. "Player/Sprite2D".

scene.description: Scene file, e.g. "res://main.tscn". Defaults to the scene open in the editor; required when the editor is closed.

name: godot_node_reparent
title: Move node
